[Download FactoryParaConfig.zip] （Please contact our official customer support team if needed.）

The FactoryParaConfig tool allows you to modify the factory parameters of each machine axis, including X, Y, Z, and U.

Important Warning:

Vendor Settings are preset configurations that directly affect machine movement and performance. We strongly recommend that you do not modify these parameters unless absolutely necessary.

Incorrect vendor settings may cause abnormal machine movement, reduced performance, or other operational issues. Only modify these parameters when instructed by the technical support team. Do not change them based on personal judgment.

 

1. Open FactoryParaConfig

Download and launch the FactoryParaConfig application.

 

2. Connect to the Machine

Select a connection method:

USB: Select USB:Auto to connect via USB.

Network / Wi-Fi: Select IP, enter the machine's IP address, and click Connect.

Check that the connection status displays Connected before proceeding.

 

3. Modify Axis Parameters

Under the Parameters section, select the axis you need to modify: X, Y, Z, or U.

The following parameters can be adjusted:

Jump-off speed: The initial speed used when the axis starts moving.

Max speed: The maximum movement speed of the axis.

Max acc: The maximum acceleration of the axis.

Note: These are reference values shown in the pictures. Actual vendor settings may vary depending on the machine model and configuration. Do not copy these values directly to your machine unless instructed by the technical support team.

After entering the confirmed values, click Save to save the changes. Repeat the process for other axes only if necessary.

 

4. Verify the Parameter Changes in RDWorks V8

Open RDWorks V8 and connect the machine to the software. Then open the Vendor Settings interface to check whether the parameter changes have been successfully applied.
